suite: DOM and Canvas API smoke (not a real browser)

tests.name: Boot creates a paused orientation dialog and valid flight readouts
Dialog close restores the flight without starting time
Direct numeric control previews and executes a budgeted maneuver
Rewind restores fuel, orbit, mission readiness, and control state
Keyboard burn and rewind work while a button has focus
Over-budget preview blocks the execute control
Every campaign route completes through UI event handlers and earns three seals
Manifest, generated routes, and fresh-flight reset are wired
Route-code selection reproduces the same dispatch and advances the next suggestion
Pause and time-warp controls advance only the chosen simulation time
Future maneuver departure, clearing, and apsis controls are wired
Atmospheric recall, failure dialog, and rewind work through UI
Manual section switches, escape-to-close, and flight recorder work
Render loop tolerates desktop and narrow canvas sizes with finite drawing coordinates
Hiding the tab pauses the simulation

limitations: Mock DOM and Canvas API only. No browser, CSS layout, pointer gesture, screen reader, audio, or pixel-level visual validation.
